guidanceConsulted.query: scroll snap css layout overflow tables semantic html
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use scrollsnapchange to synchronize active UI state with the snapped target, reflect active state in the accessibility tree (e.g. aria-current='location') because scroll-snap events do not expose state automatically, and use mandatory snapping cautiously so content larger than the viewport remains reachable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: JS example listens to scrollsnapchange with feature detection and updates aria-current='location'; prose explicitly cautions about mandatory snapping on oversized snap areas.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-scrollable code blocks, and loading='lazy' with descriptive titles on embedded iframes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <pre tabindex='0'><code>, and loading='lazy' with descriptive title on the CPS iframe.
